saveKeyText: Your vault is protected by your master password and this Secret Key. You need both to open your vault on a new device. There is no server and no way to recover them.
printHint: Print your Emergency Kit (or write the Secret Key down) and keep it with your master password somewhere safe.
saved: I have saved my Secret Key
intro: Your passwords stay on your devices. Choose a strong master password — it is the only thing you must remember.
already: Already use Password365 on another computer?
